summary: End-to-end validation of PHED mobile survey workflow (surveyor1). Backend: /api/phed/my-progress and /api/map/employee-properties are scope-aligned (total_properties=3 == phed_pending 1 + phed_in_progress 0 + phed_completed 2; both endpoints list 3 assigned properties including THS-0001 mapped to record id 6abd2d41-a7fc-479d-992a-3a72558b30aa). Auth guards on both endpoints. Frontend: on 360/390/412 widths the page body has no horizontal overflow. Map search on Properties.js is case-insensitive and trims whitespace ('  ths-0001  ' matches), owner and property id search both work, selecting a result closes the dropdown, blurs the input, opens the property modal, and Start Survey navigates to /employee/phed-survey/<exact UUID> with prefilled Property ID / owner / colony / mobile (THS-0001 / Verify Owner 1 / Didar Nagar, Thanesar / 9000000001). Back control returns to /employee/properties and the prior search query is restored via location.state.restoreSearchQuery. Water Supply Survey list (/employee/phed-survey) exposes field-property-search, clear-field-property-search, filter-pending, filter-all, start-next-btn and field-property-<UUID>; searching THS-0001 shows exactly the pending row (1 pending · 2/3 done).
critical_code_review_comments: Properties.js is ~1260 lines; consider splitting search, add-property modal, pin-adjust and map overlay into sub-components for maintainability.
phed.py at ~2372 lines and server.py at ~9229 lines are very large — split into domain modules.

In Properties.js fetchProperties(), the localStorage cache path calls setLoading(false) but the API-fetch path does not (falls through to finally); relies on finally to clear. OK, but the two branches skip setStats when cached data is served for stale cache eviction if props format changes. Consider invalidating cache on schema bump.

Search debouncing uses only propertyRequestRef for the map fetch; the search itself is synchronous filter on allProperties (fine), but there is no debouncing for rapid keystrokes — acceptable given local filtering.
Consider surfacing a visible 'Failed to load properties' banner even if toast is missed (currently mapError is only rendered inside empty-state block when a search query is active).
seed_data_creation: None. Only used seeded THS-0001 (id 6abd2d41-a7fc-479d-992a-3a72558b30aa); no writes performed — Start Survey navigation was reached but no submit was executed to avoid mutating state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend my-progress uses keys total_properties/phed_pending/phed_in_progress/phed_completed (not total/pending/in_progress/done). Map endpoint /api/map/employee-properties returns {properties: [...]} where each item has id (UUID) matching the phed-survey route. For surveyor1: total=3, pending=1, completed=2. Login redirects to /select-town before /employee. Safe test property id 6abd2d41-a7fc-479d-992a-3a72558b30aa (THS-0001, Verify Owner 1, mobile 9000000001). Skipped: a) executing a real Water Bill survey submission (safety: no writes made); b) simulating Android IME/Back — used web viewport/blur equivalents which passed.
rca of the issue: N/A — main agent's reported fixes verified working. Scope reconciliation between /phed/my-progress and /map/employee-properties is intact; map search selection routes to exact UUID; keyboard blur + list dismissal + search-context restore all confirmed on 360/390/412.
